title: Spīritūs et Accentūs
subtitle: Spīritus lēnis et asper, tria signa accentūs (acūtus, gravis, circumflexus), et iōta subscrīptum.
objectives: Distinguere spīritum lēnem (᾿) ā spīritū aspero (῾) et utrumque super vōcālem initiālem scrībere
Cognōscere tria signa accentūs (acūtus, gravis, circumflexus) et regulam generālem locī eōrum
Explicāre ubi in diphthongō signa (spīritus, accentus) scrībantur
Recognōscere iōta subscrīptum (ᾳ ῃ ῳ) et significātiōnem eius

content.intro: In Graecō scrīptō, duo genera signōrum sunt pars ipsīus orthographiae rēctae, nōn ōrnāmenta optiōnālia: spīritus (super omnem vōcālem initiālem) et accentus (super ferē omne verbum). Discere ea ab initiō melius est quam ea neglegere et posteā dēdiscere habitūs falsōs.
content.explanation: Omnis vōcālis (vel diphthongus) quae verbum incipit portat aut ᾿ (spīritum lēnem) aut ῾ (spīritum asperum) — numquam neutrum. Praetereā, omnis ρ initiālis verbī semper spīritum asperum accipit: ῥήτωρ (unde Latīnum “rhētor”, cum “rh”). In diphthongō, spīritus (et accentus, sī adest) scrībitur super secundam litteram, nōn prīmam: εἰμί, αὐτός, οὗτος.

rules.heading: a) Spīritus Lēnis et Asper
rules.body: ᾿ (spīritus lēnis) nūllum sonum addit — vōcālis simpliciter incipit sine h: ἄνθρωπος sonat “ANTHRŌPOS”, nōn “HANTHRŌPOS”. ῾ (spīritus asper) indicat sonum /h/ ante vōcālem: ὁ sonat “HO”. Nam ρ initiāle, spīritus asper (ῥ) nōn mūtat sonum ipsīus ρ multum in prōnūntiātiōne, sed persistit in trānslitterātiōne classicā (“rh”).

rules.heading: b) Tria Signa Accentūs
rules.body:
SignumNōmenUbi cadere potest
´acūtus (ὀξεῖα)in ūnā ex tribus ultimīs syllabīs
`gravis (βαρεῖα)sōlum in ultimā syllabā, cum acūtus ibi mūtātur ante aliud verbum sine pausā
˜circumflexus (περισπωμένη)sōlum in ūnā ex duābus ultimīs syllabīs, et sōlum super vōcālem longam vel diphthongum

Ferē omne verbum Graecum ūnum ex hīs tribus signīs portat; pauca verba brevia (praepositiōnēs, coniūnctiōnēs) carent accentū prōpriō et “appenduntur” phōneticē ad verbum proximum — hoc plēnius in lēctiōne Syllabae et Enclitica vidēbis.

rules.heading: c) Iōta Subscrīptum
rules.body: Cum α, η, vel ω longa antīquitus sequēbātur iōta in eādem syllabā, ea iōta hodiē scrībitur parva sub vōcāli: ᾳ ῃ ῳ (“iōta subscrīptum”). Vidēbis hanc fōrmam saepe in cāsū datīvō (Gradū II) et in certīs fōrmīs verbōrum. Prō discipulō incipiente, sonus additus ā iōtā subscrīptō omittī potest sine magnō dētrīmentō — id quod maximē interest nunc est agnōscere fōrmam scrīptam et nōn eam prō errōre typographicō habēre.

examples: ὁ ἄνθρωπος — homo ille. (spīritus asper super ὁ: sonat “HO”)
ἡ ἡμέρα — dies illa. (spīritus asper bis: ἡ et ἡμέρα)
ῥήτωρ — ōrātor. (ρ initiāle semper cum spīritū aspero)
οὗτος — hic. (spīritus super secundam litteram diphthongī ου)
τῇ ἡμέρᾳ — in diē illā. (duo exempla iōtae subscrīptī: ῃ et ᾳ)

commonMistakes.wrong: Omittere spīritum in tōtō, quasi esset ōrnāmentum optiōnāle.
commonMistakes.right: Scrībere semper aut spīritum lēnem aut asperum super omnem vōcālem initiālem — pars orthographiae rēctae est, nōn additāmentum.
commonMistakes.why: Sine spīritū, verbum male scrīptum est; cum spīritū aspero, sonus ipse mūtātur (praesentia/absentia /h/).

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere spīritum asperum esse mēram variantem graphicam sine effectū in prōnūntiātiōne.
commonMistakes.right: Spīritus asper reāliter significat sonum /h/ ante vōcālem in prōnūntiātiōne Atticā reconstrūctā.
commonMistakes.why: Confer ὁ (“ho”, spīritū aspero) et exemplum hypotheticum sine spīritū asperō: sonus vērē differt, nōn sōlum scrīptūra.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere accentum acūtum posse cadere in quāvīs syllabā verbī, ut in linguīs cum accentū līberō.
commonMistakes.right: Accentus acūtus sōlum in ūnā ex tribus ultimīs syllabīs cadere potest; circumflexus, sōlum in ūnā ex duābus ultimīs.
commonMistakes.why: Accentuātiō Graeca fīxīs rēgulīs subicitur, dēterminātā ā longitūdine syllabārum ultimārum.

exercises.title: Quīnque Verba Attestāta
exercises.instructions: Lege haec quīnque verba/phrasēs iam vīsa, deinde responde de eōrum orthographiā, nōn de sēnsū novō.
exercises.passage: ὁ ἄνθρωπος. ἡ ἡμέρα. ῥήτωρ. οὗτος. τῇ ἡμέρᾳ.

items.prompt: Quō sonō incipit verbum ὁ, propter spīritum asperum?
items.explanation: Spīritus asper super ὁ significat sonum /h/: “HO”.

items.prompt: Super quam litteram diphthongī pōnitur spīritus in οὗτος?
items.explanation: In diphthongō, spīritus scrībitur super secundam litteram.

items.prompt: Accipitne ῥήτωρ spīritum asperum, quia incipit littera ρ?
items.explanation: Omne ρ initiāle verbī Graecī accipit spīritum asperum.
Iōta subscrīptum sub α longō, vestīgium antīquae diphthongī.
Spīritus asper indicat sonum /h/ pronuntiandum ante vōcālem vel diphthongum initiālem.

items.prompt: Super quam litteram diphthongī pōnitur spīritus (et accentus, sī adest)?
items.explanation: In diphthongō, signa (spīritus et accentus) super secundam vōcālem scrībuntur, ut in εἰμί vel αὐτός.

items.prompt: Quae littera initiālis SEMPER accipit spīritum asperum?
items.explanation: Omnis ρ initiālis verbī accipit spīritum asperum (ῥ), unde Latīnum “rhētor” in verbīs mūtuātīs.

options: in ūnā ex tribus ultimīs syllabīs
items.explanation: Accentus acūtus potest cadere in ultimā, paenultimā, vel antepaenultimā syllabā (ultimīs tribus).

options: parva iōta scrīpta sub α, η, vel ω longīs
items.explanation: Iōta subscrīptum (ᾳ ῃ ῳ) est parva iōta scrīpta sub vōcālī longā, vestīgium antīquae diphthongī.

exercises.title: Iunge Signum cum Significātiōne
exercises.instructions: Iunge quodque signum cum dēscrīptiōne suā.

pairs.right: in ūnā ex tribus ultimīs syllabīs
sōlum super vōcālem longam, in ūnā ex duābus ultimīs syllabīs
parva ι sub α, η, vel ω longīs

items.explanation: Quodque signum habet fūnctiōnem propriam et locum ubi lēgitimē appārēre potest.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Omnis vōcālis initiālis verbī Graecī accipit vel spīritum lēnem vel spīritum asperum.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: nūlla vōcālis initiālis caret utrōque signō.

items.statement: Spīritus asper est mēra optiō graphica sine effectū in prōnūntiātiōne.
items.explanation: Falsum: spīritus asper reāliter significat sonum /h/ in prōnūntiātiōne Atticā.

items.statement: Accentus circumflexus potest cadere in antepaenultimā syllabā.
items.explanation: Falsum: circumflexus sōlum in ultimā vel paenultimā (duābus ultimīs) cadere potest, numquam in antepaenultimā.

items.statement: Initiālis ρ verbī Graecī semper accipit spīritum asperum.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: omne ρ initiāle habet spīritum asperum (ῥ).

summary: Omnis vōcālis initiālis (et omne ρ initiāle) portat spīritum lēnem (᾿, nūllus sonus) aut asperum (῾, sonus /h/).
In diphthongō, spīritus et accentus scrībuntur super secundam vōcālem.
Tria signa accentūs: acūtus (ultimīs tribus syllabīs), gravis (sōlum ultimā, ante aliud verbum), circumflexus (sōlum ultimīs duābus, super vōcālem longam).
Iōta subscrīptum (ᾳ ῃ ῳ) est vestīgium antīquae diphthongī sub α, η, ω longīs.
